newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - Digital, Cyrix up.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - Digital, Cyrix up.

text.p: Digital Equipment Corp shares rallied preceding Thursday's U.S. market open after the company reported fiscal third quarter earnings per share that exceeded Wall Street expectations, traders said.
In early third market trade, Digital shares rose two to 28.

Digital announced earlier this morning earnings of $0.27 per share for the period ended March 29, $0.03 above the First Call consensus estimate though below the $0.74 per share profit posted one year ago.
Cyrix Corp shares also climbed after reporting robust first quarter results following last night's market close.
Cyrix shares traded at 22-1/2, climbing from 17-3/4 at Wednesday's Nasdaq market close and adding 1-1/2 to last night's after-hours gain.
The computer-chip maker said it earned $0.33 per share in the first quarter, up from $0.10 one year ago.
ESS Technology Inc shares dropped to 13-3/4 from 22-1/16 after it warned price pressure in the audio and video markets is expected to result in slimmer margins in the second quarter.
The outlook accompanied the ESS's first quarter earnings announcement of $0.43 per share profit versus a loss of $0.55.
"The company reported a penny better (than expectations), the the second quarter margin pressure is affecting the stock," a trader said.
